methods.name: AboutBox
methods.documentation: Displays a dialog identifying the DataWindow, including copyright and version information.

methods.name: AcceptText
methods.documentation: Applies the contents of the DataWindow's edit control to the current item in the buffer of a DataWindow control or DataStore. The data in the edit control must pass the validation rule for the column before it can be stored in the item.

methods.name: CanUndo
methods.documentation: Tests whether Undo can reverse the most recent edit in the editable control over the current row and column.

methods.name: CategoryCount
methods.documentation: Counts the number of categories on the category axis of a graph.

params.name: graphcontrol
params.description: A string whose value is the name of the graph in the DataWindow for which you want the number of categories

methods.name: CategoryName
methods.documentation: Obtains the category name associated with the specified category number.
methods.syntax: string dwcontrol.CategoryName ( string graphcontrol, integer categorynumber )

params.name: graphcontrol
params.description: A string whose value is the name of the graph in the DataWindow for which you want the name of a specific category

params.name: categorynumber
params.description: The number of the category for which you want the name

methods.name: ClassName
methods.documentation: Provides the class (or name) of the specified object.

methods.name: Clear
methods.documentation: Deletes selected text in the edit control over the current row and column, but does not store it in the clipboard.

methods.name: ClearValues
methods.documentation: Deletes all the items from a value list or code table associated with a DataWindow column. (A value list is called a code table when it has both display and data values.) ClearValues does not affect the data stored in the column.
methods.syntax: integer dwcontrol.ClearValues ( string column ) integer dwcontrol.ClearValues ( integer column )

params.name: column
params.description: The column whose value list you want to delete. Column can be a column number (integer) or a column name (string).

methods.name: Clipboard
methods.documentation: Replaces the contents of the system clipboard with a bitmap image of a graph. You can paste the image into other applications.

params.name: graphcontrol
params.description: A string whose value is the name of the graph in the DataWindow object

methods.name: Collapse
methods.documentation: Collapses a group in a TreeView DataWindow that has the specified TreeView level and includes the specified row.

params.name: row
params.description: The number of the row that belongs to the TreeView level of the group to be collapsed

params.name: groupLevel
params.description: The TreeView level of the group to be collapsed

methods.name: CollapseAll
methods.documentation: Collapses all groups in a TreeView DataWindow.

methods.name: CollapseAllChildren
methods.documentation: Collapses a group in a TreeView DataWindow that has the specified TreeView level and includes the specified row; also collapses all the group's children.

params.name: dw_control
params.description: A reference to a TreeView-style DataWindow control

params.name: row
params.description: The number of the row that belongs to the group to be collapsed

params.name: groupLevel
params.description: The TreeView level of the group to be collapsed

methods.name: CollapseLevel
methods.documentation: Collapses all the groups in a TreeView DataWindow that have the specified TreeView level.

params.name: groupLevel
params.description: The TreeView level of the group to be collapsed

methods.name: Copy
methods.documentation: Puts selected text from the current row and column of an edit control onto the clipboard. Copy does not change the source text.

methods.name: CopyRTF
methods.documentation: Returns the selected text, pictures, and input fields in a RichText DataWindow as a string with rich text formatting. Bitmaps and input fields are included in the string.
methods.syntax: string dwcontrol.CopyRTF ( { boolean selected {, Band band } } )

params.name: selected
params.description: A value indicating whether to copy selected text only. Values are: true -- (Default) Copy selected text only. false -- Copy the entire contents of the band.

params.name: band
params.description: A value specifying the band from which to copy text. For a list of valid values, see Band . The default is the band that contains the insertion point.

methods.name: Create
methods.documentation: Creates a DataWindow object using DataWindow source code and puts that object in the specified DataWindow control or DataStore object. This dynamic DataWindow object does not become a permanent part of the application source library.
methods.syntax: integer dwcontrol.Create ( string syntax {, string errorbuffer } )

params.name: syntax
params.description: A string whose value is the DataWindow source code that will be used to create the DataWindow object.

params.name: errorbuffer
params.description: The name of a string that will hold any error messages that are generated. If you do not specify an error buffer, a message box will display the error messages.

methods.name: CreateError
methods.documentation: Returns the error messages that were generated during a previous call to Create.

methods.name: CreateFrom
methods.documentation: Creates a DataStore object from the passed ResultSet object.

params.name: rssource
params.description: A ResultSet or ADOResultSet object that contains meta data from which the DataStore object is created

methods.name: CrosstabDialog
methods.documentation: Displays the Crosstab Definition dialog box so the user can modify the definition of a crosstab DataWindow at runtime. The dialog box is the one you use in the DataWindow painter to define the crosstab.

methods.name: Cut
methods.documentation: Deletes selected text in the current row and column of an edit control and stores it on the clipboard, replacing the clipboard contents with the deleted text.

methods.name: DataCount
methods.documentation: Reports the number of data points in the specified series in a graph.
methods.syntax: long dwcontrol.DataCount ( string graphcontrol, string seriesname )

params.name: graphcontrol
params.description: The name of the graph in the DataWindow control

params.name: seriesname
params.description: A string whose value is the name of the series for which you want the number of data points

methods.name: DBCancel
methods.documentation: Cancels the retrieval in process in a DataWindow.

methods.name: DBErrorCode
methods.documentation: Reports the database-specific error code that triggered the DBError event.

methods.name: DBErrorMessage
methods.documentation: Reports the database-specific error message that triggered the DBError event.

methods.name: DeletedCount
methods.documentation: Reports the number of rows that have been marked for deletion in the database.

methods.name: DeleteRow
methods.documentation: Deletes a row from a DataWindow control, DataStore object, or child DataWindow.

params.name: row
params.description: A value identifying the row you want to delete. To delete the current row, specify 0 for row.

methods.name: Describe
methods.documentation: Reports the values of properties of a DataWindow object and controls within the DataWindow object. Each column and graphic control in the DataWindow has a set of properties (listed in DataWindow Object Properties ). You specify one or more properties as a string, and Describe returns the values of the properties. Describe can also evaluate expressions involving values of a particular row and column. When you include Describe's Evaluate function in the property list, the value of the evaluated expression is included in the reported information.

params.name: propertylist
params.description: A string whose value is a blank-separated list of properties or Evaluate functions. For a list of valid properties, see DataWindow Object Properties

methods.name: Drag
methods.documentation: Starts or ends the dragging of a control.

params.name: dragvalue
params.description: A value indicating the action you want to take on a control: Begin! -- Put dwcontrol in drag mode. Cancel! -- Stop dragging dwcontrol but do not cause a DragDrop event. End! -- Stop dragging dwcontrol and if dwcontrol is over a target object, cause a DragDrop event.

methods.name: Expand
methods.documentation: Expands a group in a TreeView DataWindow that has the specified TreeView level and includes the specified row.

params.name: row
params.description: The number of the row that belongs to the TreeView level of the group to be expanded

params.name: groupLevel
params.description: The TreeView level of the group to be expanded

methods.name: ExpandAll
methods.documentation: Expands all groups in a TreeView DataWindow.

methods.name: ExpandAllChildren
methods.documentation: Expands a group in a TreeView DataWindow that has the specified TreeView level and includes the specified row; also expands all the group's children.

params.name: row
params.description: The number of the row that belongs to the group to be expanded

params.name: groupLevel
params.description: The TreeView level of the group to be expanded

methods.name: ExpandLevel
methods.documentation: Expands all the groups in a TreeView DataWindow that have the specified TreeView level.

params.name: groupLevel
params.description: The TreeView level of the group to be expanded

methods.name: ExportRowAsJson
methods.documentation: Exports a data row from the specified buffer of a DataWindow control, DataStore object, or DataWindowChild object to the JSON string. The exported JSON string will be a one-level plain JSON string. For details, see Plain JSON: one-level structure in Application Techniques .

params.name: row
params.description: A long value identifying the row of data to be exported. 1 indicates the first row. The following number is invalid: 0, a negative value, or a value greater than the row count.

params.name: dwbuffer
params.description: A value of the dwBuffer enumerated datatype identifying the DataWindow buffer from which you want to export the data. For a list of valid values, see DWBuffer . If not specified, exports the data from the Primary! buffer. If specified, exports the data from the specified buffer.

methods.name: Filter
methods.documentation: Displays rows in a DataWindow that pass the current filter criteria. Rows that do not meet the filter criteria are moved to the filter buffer.

methods.name: FilteredCount
methods.documentation: Reports the number of rows that are not displayed in the DataWindow because of the current filter criteria.

methods.name: Find
methods.documentation: Finds the next row in a DataWindow or DataStore in which data meets a specified condition.
methods.syntax: long dwcontrol.Find ( string expression, long start, long end{, DWBuffer buffer} )

params.name: expression
params.description: A string whose value is a boolean expression that you want to use as the search criterion. The expression includes column names.

params.name: start
params.description: A value identifying the row location at which to begin the search. Start can be greater than the number of rows.

params.name: end
params.description: A value identifying the row location at which to end the search. End can be greater than the number of rows. To search backward, make end less than start.

params.name: buffer
params.description: The name of the buffer from which you want to find data. Values are: Primary -- (Default) The data in the primary buffer (the data that has not been deleted or filtered out). Delete -- The data in the delete buffer (data deleted from the DataWindow control). Filter -- The data in the filter buffer (data that was filtered out).

methods.name: FindCategory
methods.documentation: Obtains the number of a category in a graph when you know the category's label. The category values label the category axis.
methods.syntax: integer dwcontrol.FindCategory ( string graphcontrol, date categoryvalue ) integer dwcontrol.FindCategory ( string graphcontrol, datetime categoryvalue ) integer dwcontrol.FindCategory ( string graphcontrol, double categoryvalue ) integer dwcontrol.FindCategory ( string graphcontrol, string categoryvalue ) integer dwcontrol.FindCategory ( string graphcontrol, time categoryvalue )

params.name: graphcontrol
params.description: A string whose value is the name of the graph in the DataWindow control.

params.name: categoryvalue
params.description: A value that is the category for which you want the number. The value you specify must be the same datatype as the datatype of the category axis.

methods.name: FindGroupChange
methods.documentation: Searches for the next break for the specified group. A group break occurs when the value in the column for the group changes. FindGroupChange reports the row that begins the next section.
methods.syntax: long dwcontrol.FindGroupChange ( long row, integer level )

params.name: row
params.description: A value identifying the row at which you want to begin searching for the group break.

params.name: level
params.description: The number of the group for which you are searching. Groups are numbered in the order in which you defined them.

methods.name: FindNext
methods.documentation: Finds the next occurrence of text in a RichTextEdit DataWindow control and highlights it, using criteria set up in a previous call of the Find method.

methods.name: FindRequired
methods.documentation: Reports the next row and column that is required and contains a null value. The method arguments that specify where to start searching also store the results of the search. You can speed up the search by specifying that FindRequired check only inserted and modified rows.
methods.syntax: integer dwcontrol.FindRequired ( DWBuffer dwbuffer, long row, integer colnbr, string colname, boolean updateonly )

params.name: dwbuffer
params.description: A value indicating the DataWindow buffer you want to search for required columns. Valid buffers are: Primary! Filter!

params.name: row
params.description: A value identifying the first row to be searched. Row also stores the number of the found row. FindRequired increments the row number automatically after it validates each row's columns. When it finds a row with a required column that contains a null value, the row number is stored in row. After FindRequired validates the last column in the last row, it sets row to 0. PowerBuilder The row argument must be a variable so it can return a value for the found row.

params.name: colnbr
params.description: A value identifying the first column to be searched. Colnbr also stores the number of the found column. After validating the last column, FindRequired sets colnbr to 1 and increments row. When it finds a required column that contains a null value, the column number is stored in colnbr. PowerBuilder The colnbr argument must be a variable so it can return a value for the found column.

params.name: colname
params.description: A string in which you want to store the name of the required column that contains a null value (the name of colnbr). PowerBuilder The colname argument must be a variable so it can hold a value for the name of the found column.

params.name: updateonly
params.description: A value indicating whether you want to validate all rows and columns or only rows that have been inserted or modified: true -- Validate only those rows that have changed. Setting updateonly to true enhances performance in large DataWindows. false -- Validate all rows and columns.

methods.name: FindRequiredColumn
methods.documentation: Returns the column number that the FindRequired method found. The column is being reported because it is a required column but contains a null value. You must call FindRequired first to search for the required but missing information.

methods.name: FindRequiredColumnName
methods.documentation: Returns the column name that the FindRequired method found. The column is being reported because it is a required column but contains a null value. You must call FindRequired first to search for the required but missing information.

methods.name: FindRequiredRow
methods.documentation: Returns the row number that the FindRequired method found. The row is being reported because it contains a required column that has a null value. You must call FindRequired first to search for the required but missing information.

methods.name: FindSeries
methods.documentation: Obtains the number of a series in a graph when you know the series' name.
methods.syntax: integer dwcontrol.FindSeries ( string graphcontrol, string seriesname )

params.name: graphcontrol
params.description: A string whose value is the name of the graph in the DataWindow control

params.name: seriesname
params.description: A string whose value is the name of the series for which you want the number

methods.name: Generate
methods.documentation: Creates HTML syntax for the Web DataWindow.

methods.name: GenerateHTMLForm
methods.documentation: Creates an HTML Form element containing columns for one or more rows in a DataWindow control or DataStore. This method also returns an HTML Style element containing style sheet information.
methods.syntax: integer dwcontrol.GenerateHTMLForm ( string syntax, string style, string action { , long startrow, long endrow, integer startcolumn, integer endcolumn {, DWBuffer buffer } } )

methods.name: GenerateResultSet
methods.documentation: Generates a result set from data in a DataStore or DataWindow control. In PowerBuilder, when the result set is generated in a component on a transaction server, the format of the result set is ADO Recordset on MTS.

params.name: rsdest
params.description: The ResultSet object into which the data in the DataStore is written. This value is passed by reference.

params.name: dwbuffer
params.description: A value of the dwBuffer enumerated datatype identifying the DataWindow buffer containing the data for the result set. The default is the primary buffer. For a list of valid values, see DWBuffer .

methods.name: GenerateXHTML
methods.documentation: Generates the inline content of the Web DataWindow in XHTML.

methods.name: GenerateXMLWeb
methods.documentation: Generates the XML content and the XSLT and CSS style sheets for a Web DataWindow, which is transformed to XHTML on the client side.

methods.name: GetBandAtPointer
methods.documentation: Reports the band in which the pointer is currently located, as well as the row number associated with the band. The bands are the headers, trailers, and detail areas of the DataWindow and correspond to the horizontal areas of the DataWindow painter.

methods.name: GetBorderStyle
methods.documentation: Reports the border style of a column in a DataWindow control or DataStore object.
methods.syntax: border dwcontrol.GetBorderStyle ( integer column ) border dwcontrol.GetBorderStyle ( string column )

params.name: column
params.description: The column for which you want to obtain the border style. Column can be a column number or a column name.

methods.name: GetChanges
methods.documentation: Retrieves changes made to a DataWindow or DataStore as a blob. This method is used primarily in distributed applications.
methods.syntax: long dwcontrol.GetChanges ( REF blob changeblob {, blob cookie } )

params.name: changeblob
params.description: A variable into which the returned DataWindow changes will be placed.

params.name: cookie
params.description: A read-only blob created by GetStateStatus that is compared with the changeblob to determine the likely success of a subsequent call to SetChanges. This argument is obsolete and will be disabled in a future release.

methods.name: GetChangesBlob
methods.documentation: Returns changes made to a DataWindow or DataStore. You must call GetChanges first to set up the change information. This method is used primarily in distributed applications.

methods.name: GetChild
methods.documentation: Provides a reference to a child DataWindow or to a report in a composite DataWindow, which you can use in DataWindow functions to manipulate that DataWindow or report.
methods.syntax: integer dwcontrol.GetChild (string name, REF DataWindowChild dwchildvariable )

params.name: name
params.description: A string that names the column containing the child DataWindow or that names the report in the composite DataWindow.

params.name: dwchildvariable
params.description: A variable in which you want to store the reference to the child DataWindow or report.

methods.name: GetChildObject
methods.documentation: Gets the reference to a child object for a Web ActiveX DataWindow.

methods.name: GetClickedColumn
methods.documentation: Obtains the number of the column the user clicked or double-clicked in a DataWindow control or DataStore object.

methods.name: GetClickedRow
methods.documentation: Obtains the number of the row the user clicked or double-clicked in a DataWindow control or DataStore object.

methods.name: GetColumn
methods.documentation: Obtains the number of the current column. The current column is the column that has focus.

methods.name: GetColumnName
methods.documentation: Obtains the name of the current column. The current column is the column that has the focus.

methods.name: GetContextService
methods.documentation: Returns a reference to a context-specific instance of the specified service.
methods.syntax: integer objectname.GetContextService ( string servicename, PowerObject servicereference )

params.name: servicename
params.description: String specifying the service object. Valid values include: ContextInformation -- Context information service Internet -- Internet service ContextKeyword -- Context keyword service

params.name: servicereference
params.description: PowerObject into which the method places a reference to the service object specified by servicename. This argument is passed by reference.

methods.name: GetData
methods.documentation: Gets the value of a data point in a series in a graph when the values axis has numeric values.
methods.syntax: double dwcontrol.GetData ( string graphcontrol, integer seriesnumber, long datapoint {, grDataType datatype } )

params.name: graphcontrol
params.description: A string whose value is the name of the graph in the DataWindow control.

params.name: seriesnumber
params.description: The number that identifies the series from which you want data.

params.name: datapoint
params.description: The number of the data point for which you want the value.

params.name: datatype
params.description: A value of the grDataType enumerated datatype (in PowerBuilder) specifying whether you want the x or y value of the data point in a scatter graph. Values are: xValue! -- The x value of the data point. yValue! -- (Default) The y value of the data point. For more information, see grDataType .

methods.name: GetDataDateVariable
methods.documentation: Returns the value associated with a data point in a graph in a DataWindow object when the values axis has the date datatype. You must call GetDataDate first to retrieve the line style information. (GetDataDate is based on GetDataValue and is documented in that entry.)

methods.name: GetDataLabelling
methods.documentation: Determines whether the data at a given data point is labeled in a DirectX 3D graph.

params.name: dwcontrol
params.description: A reference to the DataWindow control containing the graph.

params.name: graphcontrol
params.description: A string whose value is the name of the graph in the DataWindow control.

params.name: series
params.description: The string that identifies the series in which you want the data labelling value.

params.name: datapoint
params.description: The data point for which you want to obtain a label.

params.name: value
params.description: Boolean passed by reference to indicate whether the data point has a label.

methods.name: GetDataNumberVariable
methods.documentation: Returns the value associated with a data point in a graph in a DataWindow object when the values axis has a numeric datatype. You must call GetDataNumber first to retrieve the line style information. (GetDataNumber is based on GetDataValue and is documented in that entry.)

methods.name: GetDataPieExplode
methods.documentation: Reports the percentage of the pie graph's radius that a pie slice is moved away from the center of the pie graph. An exploded slice is moved away from the center of the pie in order to draw attention to the data.
methods.syntax: integer dwcontrol.GetDataPieExplode ( string graphcontrol, integer series, integer datapoint, REF integer percentage )

params.name: graphcontrol
params.description: A string whose value is the name of the graph in the DataWindow control

params.name: series
params.description: The number that identifies the series

params.name: datapoint
params.description: The number of the exploded data point (that is, the pie slice)

params.name: percentage
params.description: An integer variable in which you want to store the percentage that the pie slice is exploded

methods.name: GetDataPieExplodePercentage
methods.documentation: Returns the percentage value that a slice is exploded in a pie graph in a DataWindow object. You must call GetDataPieExplode first to retrieve the information and then call this method to get the value.

methods.name: GetDataStringVariable
methods.documentation: Returns the value associated with a data point in a graph in a DataWindow object when the values axis has the string datatype. You must call GetDataString first to retrieve the line style information. (GetDataString is based on GetDataValue and is documented in that entry.)

methods.name: GetDataStyleColorValue
methods.documentation: Returns the color value associated with a data point in a graph in a DataWindow object. You must call GetDataStyleColor first to retrieve the color information. (See GetDataStyle for information about this method.)

methods.name: GetDataStyleFillPattern
methods.documentation: Returns the fill pattern associated with a data point in a graph in a DataWindow object. You must call GetDataStyleFill first to retrieve the fill information. (See GetDataStyle for information about this method.)

methods.name: GetDataStyleLineStyle
methods.documentation: Returns the line style associated with a data point in a graph in a DataWindow object. You must call GetDataStyleLine first to retrieve the line style information. (See GetDataStyle for information about this method.)

methods.name: GetDataStyleLineWidth
methods.documentation: Returns the line width associated with a data point in a graph in a DataWindow object. You must call GetDataStyleLine first to retrieve the line style information. (See GetDataStyle for information about this method.)

methods.name: GetDataStyleSymbolValue
methods.documentation: Returns the symbol associated with a data point in a graph in a DataWindow object. You must call GetDataStyleSymbol first to retrieve the symbol information. (See GetDataStyle for information about this method.)

methods.name: GetDataTransparency
methods.documentation: Obtains the transparency percentage of a data point in a DirectX 3D graph (those with 3D rendering).
methods.syntax: integer dwcontrol.GetDataTransparency ( string graphcontrol, integer seriesnumber, int datapoint, REF int transparency)

params.name: graphcontrol
params.description: A string whose value is the name of the graph in the DataWindow control.

params.name: seriesnumber
params.description: The number that identifies the series from which you want data.

params.name: datapoint
params.description: The number of the data point for which you want the transparency value.

params.name: transparency
params.description: Integer value for percent transparency. A value of 0 means that the data point is opaque and a value of 100 means that it is completely transparent.

methods.name: GetDataValue
methods.documentation: Obtains the value of a data point in a series in a graph.
methods.syntax: integer dwcontrol.GetDataValue ( string graphcontrol, integer seriesnumber, long datapoint, REF date datavariable {, grDataType XorY } ) integer dwcontrol.GetDataValue ( string graphcontrol, integer seriesnumber, long datapoint, REF datetime datavariable {, grDataType XorY } ) integer dwcontrol.GetDataValue ( string graphcontrol, integer seriesnumber, long datapoint, REF double datavariable {, grDataType XorY } ) integer dwcontrol.GetDataValue ( string graphcontrol, integer seriesnumber, long datapoint, REF string datavariable {, grDataType XorY } ) integer dwcontrol.GetDataValue ( string graphcontrol, integer seriesnumber, long datapoint, REF time datavariable {, grDataType XorY } )

params.name: graphcontrol
params.description: A string whose value is the name of the graph in the DataWindow control.

params.name: seriesnumber
params.description: The number that identifies the series from which you want data.

params.name: datapoint
params.description: The number of the data point for which you want the value.

params.name: datavariable
params.description: The name of a variable that will hold the data value. The variable's datatype can be date, DateTime, double, string, or time. The variable must have the same datatype as the values axis of the graph.

params.name: xory
params.description: A value of the grDataType enumerated datatype (in PowerBuilder) specifying whether you want the x or y value of the data point in a scatter graph. For values, see grDataType .

methods.name: GetFormat
methods.documentation: Obtains the display format assigned to a column in a DataWindow control or DataStore object.
methods.syntax: string dwcontrol.GetFormat ( string column ) string dwcontrol.GetFormat ( integer column )

params.name: column
params.description: The column for which you want the display format. Column can be a column number (integer) or a column name (string).

methods.name: GetFullContext
methods.documentation: This method returns a string representing the context of the client-side control to be passed on a form submit.

methods.name: GetFullState
methods.documentation: Retrieves the complete state of a DataWindow or DataStore as a blob. This method is used primarily in distributed applications.

params.name: dwasblob
params.description: A variable into which the returned DataWindow will be placed.

methods.name: GetFullStateBlob
methods.documentation: Returns the state of a DataWindow or DataStore. You must call GetFullState first to set up the state information. This method is used primarily in distributed applications.

methods.name: GetItem
methods.documentation: Gets the value of an item for the specified row and column in a Web DataWindow client control. Use one of the datatype-specific methods such as GetItemString for other types of DataWindow control. GetItem returns the value available in the data available to the client. This is equivalent to the primary buffer in other environments.

methods.name: GetItemDate
methods.documentation: Gets data whose type is Date from the specified buffer of a DataWindow control or DataStore object. You can obtain the data that was originally retrieved and stored in the database from the original buffer, as well as the current value in the primary, delete, or filter buffers.
methods.syntax: date dwcontrol.GetItemDate ( long row, string column {, DWBuffer dwbuffer , boolean originalvalue } ) date dwcontrol.GetItemDate ( long row, integer column {, DWBuffer dwbuffer, boolean originalvalue } )

params.name: row
params.description: A value identifying the row location of the data.

params.name: column
params.description: The column location of the data. The datatype of the column must be date. Column can be a column number or a column name. The column number is the number of the column as it is listed in the Column Specification view of the DataWindow painter -- not necessarily the number of the column in the Design view. To get the contents of a computed field, specify the name of the computed field for column. Computed fields do not have numbers.

params.name: dwbuffer
params.description: A value identifying the DataWindow buffer from which you want to get the data. For a list of valid values, see DWBuffer .

params.name: originalvalue
params.description: A boolean indicating whether you want the original or current values for row and column: True -- Returns the original values (the values initially retrieved from the database). False -- (Default) Returns the current values. If you specify dwbuffer, you must also specify originalvalue.

methods.name: GetItemDateTime
methods.documentation: Gets data whose type is DateTime from the specified buffer of a DataWindow control or DataStore object. You can obtain the data that was originally retrieved and stored in the database from the original buffer, as well as the current value in the primary, delete, or filter buffers.
methods.syntax: DateTime dwcontrol.GetItemDateTime ( long row, string column {, DWBuffer dwbuffer, boolean originalvalue } ) DateTime dwcontrol.GetItemDateTime ( long row, integer column {, DWBuffer dwbuffer, boolean originalvalue } )

params.name: row
params.description: A value identifying the row location of the data.

params.name: column
params.description: The column location of the data. The datatype of the column must be DateTime. Column can be a column number or a column name. The column number is the number of the column as it is listed in the Column Specification view of the DataWindow painter -- not necessarily the number of the column in the Design view. To get the contents of a computed field, specify the name of the computed field for column. Computed fields do not have numbers.

params.name: dwbuffer
params.description: A value identifying the DataWindow buffer from which you want to get the data. For a list of valid values, see DWBuffer .

params.name: originalvalue
params.description: A boolean indicating whether you want the original or current values for row and column: True -- Returns the original values, that is, the values initially retrieved from the database. False -- (Default) Returns the current values. If you specify dwbuffer, you must also specify originalvalue.

methods.name: GetItemDecimal
methods.documentation: Gets data whose type is decimal from the specified buffer of a DataWindow control or DataStore object. You can obtain the data that was originally retrieved and stored in the database from the original buffer, as well as the current value in the primary, delete, or filter buffers.
methods.syntax: decimal dwcontrol.GetItemDecimal ( long row, integer column {, DWBuffer dwbuffer, boolean originalvalue } ) decimal dwcontrol.GetItemDecimal ( long row, string column {, DWBuffer dwbuffer, boolean originalvalue } )

params.name: row
params.description: A value identifying the row location of the decimal data.

params.name: column

params.description: A variable into which the returned warning or error message will be placed. When there are a large amount of error messages, the error information will only display the total number of errors, and the detailed message of the first 10 errors. The import warning caused by data type mismatch will not affect the return value of ImportJson; although the data of the mismatched columns will not be imported, the rest columns (even only one column) that are matched will be imported successfully; and that row will be regarded as a successful import and counted into the return value. The import error caused by DW presentation style mismatch, invalid arguments, startrow value greater than the number of rows, etc. will be regarded as a failure, and represented by a negative return value of ImportJson, instead of being placed into this variable. See the Return Value section for more. Most of the messages placed into this variable are warnings (such as data type mismatch) rather than errors. Developers can adjust the JSON data according to the message or simply ignore the message if the problematic column is not critical and the corresponding DataWindow column can be left blank.
