params.name: dwbuffer
params.description: A value of the dwBuffer enumerated datatype identifying the DataWindow buffer from which you want to import the data. For a list of valid values, see DWBuffer . If not specified, imports the JSON data to the Primary! buffer. If specified, imports the JSON data to the specified buffer.

methods.name: ImportString
methods.documentation: Inserts data into a DataWindow control or DataStore from tab-separated, comma-separated, or XML data in a string.
methods.syntax: long dwcontrol.ImportString ( {saveastype importtype}, string string {, long startrow {, long endrow {,long startcolumn {, long endcolumn {, long dwstartcolumn } } } } } )

params.name: importtype
params.description: An enumerated value of the SaveAsType DataWindow constant or a string or number representing that value (see SaveAsType ). Valid type arguments are: Text! CSV! XML! If you want to generate an XML trace file, the XML! argument is required.

params.name: string
params.description: A string from which you want to copy the data. The string should contain tab-separated or comma-separated columns or XML with one row per line (see Usage).

params.name: startrow
params.description: The number of the first detail row in the string that you want to copy. The default is 1. For default XML import, if startrow is supplied, the first N (startrow -1) elements are skipped, where N is the DataWindow row size. For template XML import, if startrow is supplied, the first (startrow -1) occurrences of the repetitive row mapping defined in the template are skipped.

params.name: endrow
params.description: The number of the last detail row in the string that you want to copy. The default is the rest of the rows. For default XML import, if endrow is supplied, import stops when N * endrow elements have been imported, where N is the DataWindow row size. For template XML import, if endrow is supplied, import stops after endrow occurrences of the repetitive row mapping defined in the template have been imported.

params.name: startcolumn
params.description: The number of the first column in the string that you want to copy. The default is 1. For default XML import, if startcolumn is supplied, import skips the first (startcolumn - 1) elements in each row. This argument has no effect on template XML import.

params.name: endcolumn
params.description: The number of the last column in the string that you want to copy. The default is the rest of the columns. For default XML import, if endcolumn is supplied and is smaller than N, where N is the DataWindow row size, import skips the last (N - endcolumn) elements in each row. This argument has no effect on template XML import.

params.name: dwstartcolumn
params.description: The number of the first column in the DataWindow control or DataStore that should receive data. The default is 1. This argument is supported for default and template XML import.

methods.name: InsertDocument
methods.documentation: Inserts a rich text format or plain text file into a DataWindow control or DataStore object. The new content is added in one of two ways:
methods.syntax: integer dwcontrol.InsertDocument ( string filename, boolean clearflag, FileType filetype)

params.name: filename
params.description: A string whose value is the name of the file you want to display in the RichTextEdit control. Filename can include the file's path.

params.name: clearflag
params.description: A boolean value specifying whether the new file will replace the current contents of the control. Values are: True -- Replace the current contents with the file. false -- Insert the file into the existing contents at the insertion point.

params.name: filetype
params.description: A value of the FileType enumerated datatype specifying the type of file being opened. Values are: FileTypeRichText! -- (Default) The file being opened is in rich text format (RTF). FileTypeText! -- The file being opened is plain ASCII text (TXT). FileTypeHTML! -- The file being opened is in HTML format (HTM or HTML) FileTypeDoc! -- The file being opened is in Microsoft Word format (DOC)

methods.name: InsertRow
methods.documentation: Inserts a row in a DataWindow or DataStore. If any columns have default values, the row is initialized with these values before it is displayed.

params.name: row
params.description: A value identifying the row before which you want to insert a row. To insert a row at the end, specify 0.

methods.name: IsExpanded
methods.documentation: Performs a test to see whether a group in a TreeView DataWindow with the specified TreeView level is expanded, and whether the group includes the specified row.

params.name: row
params.description: The number of the row that belongs to the group

params.name: groupLevel
params.description: The TreeView level of the group

methods.name: IsRowSelected
methods.documentation: Determines whether a row is selected in a DataWindow. A selected row is highlighted using reverse video.

methods.name: IsSelected
methods.documentation: Determines whether a row is selected in a DataWindow or DataStore. A selected row is highlighted using reverse video.

params.name: row
params.description: A value identifying the row you want to test to see if it is selected

methods.name: LineCount
methods.documentation: Determines the number of lines in an edit control that allows multiple lines.

methods.name: ModifiedCount
methods.documentation: Reports the number of rows that have been modified but not updated in a DataWindow or DataStore.

methods.name: Modify
methods.documentation: Modifies a DataWindow object by applying specifications, given as a list of instructions, that change the DataWindow object's definition. You can change appearance, behavior, and database information for the DataWindow object by changing the values of properties. You can add and remove controls from the DataWindow object by providing specifications for the controls.

params.name: modstring
params.description: A string whose value is the specifications for the modification. See Usage for appropriate formats.

methods.name: Move
methods.documentation: Moves a control or object to another position relative to its parent window, or for some window objects, relative to the screen.

params.name: objectname
params.description: A reference to an object or control you want to move

params.name: x
params.description: The x coordinate of the new location in PowerBuilder units

params.name: y
params.description: The y coordinate of the new location in PowerBuilder units

methods.name: ObjectAtPointer
methods.documentation: Finds out where the user clicked in a graph. ObjectAtPointer reports the region of the graph under the pointer and stores the associated series and data point numbers in the designated variables.
methods.syntax: grObjectType dwcontrol.ObjectAtPointer ( string graphcontrol, REF integer seriesnumber, REF integer datapoint )

params.name: graphcontrol
params.description: A string whose value is the name of the graph in the DataWindow control.

params.name: seriesnumber
params.description: In PowerBuilder, an integer variable in which you want to store the number of the series under the pointer.

params.name: datapoint
params.description: In PowerBuilder, an integer variable in which you want to store the number of the data point under the pointer.

methods.name: ObjectAtPointerDataPoint
methods.documentation: Returns the number of the data point under the pointer. You must call ObjectAtPointer first to retrieve the pointer position information.

methods.name: ObjectAtPointerSeries
methods.documentation: Returns the number of the series under the pointer. You must call ObjectAtPointer first to retrieve the pointer position information.

methods.name: OLEActivate
methods.documentation: Activates Object Linking and Embedding (OLE) for the specified object and sends the specified command verb to the OLE server application.
methods.syntax: integer dwcontrol.OLEActivate ( long row, integer column, integer verb ) integer dwcontrol.OLEActivate ( long row, string column, integer verb )

params.name: row
params.description: A long identifying the row location of the Database Blob control in the DataWindow object.

params.name: column
params.description: The column location of the Database Blob. Column can be a column number (integer) or a column name (string).

params.name: verb
params.description: Usually 0, but the verb is dependent on the OLE server.

methods.name: OneTrip
methods.documentation: Generates HTML syntax for the Web DataWindow after setting values that refresh the state of the server component so that it is in sync with user actions.

methods.name: Paste
methods.documentation: Inserts (pastes) the contents of the clipboard into the specified control. If no text is selected in the control, the text on the clipboard is pasted at the insertion point. If text is selected, Paste replaces the selected text with the text on the clipboard.

methods.name: PasteRTF
methods.documentation: Pastes rich text data from a string into a DataWindow control or DataStore object.
methods.syntax: long rtename.PasteRTF ( string richtextstring {, Band band } )

params.name: richtextstring
params.description: A string whose value is data with rich text formatting.

params.name: band
params.description: A value specifying the band into which the rich text data is pasted. For a list of valid values, see Band . The default is the band that contains the insertion point.

methods.name: PointerX
methods.documentation: Determines the distance of the pointer from the left edge of the specified object.

methods.name: PointerY
methods.documentation: Determines the distance of the pointer from the top of the specified object.

methods.name: PostEvent
methods.documentation: Adds an event to the end of the event queue of an object.
methods.syntax: boolean objectname.PostEvent ( TrigEvent event {, long word, long long } ) boolean objectname.PostEvent ( TrigEvent event {, long word, string long } )

params.name: event
params.description: A value of the TrigEvent enumerated datatype that identifies a PowerBuilder event (for example, Clicked!, Modified!, or DoubleClicked!) or a string whose value is the name of an event. The event must be a valid event for objectname and a script must exist for the event in objectname.

params.name: word
params.description: A value to be stored in the WordParm property of the system's Message object. If you want to specify a value for long, but not for word, enter 0. (For cross-platform compatibility, WordParm and LongParm are both longs.)

params.name: long
params.description: A value that you want to store in the LongParm property of the system's Message object. When you specify a string, a pointer to the string is stored in the LongParm property, which you can access with the String function (see Usage).

methods.name: ReplaceText
methods.documentation: Replaces selected text in the edit control for the current row and column with a specified string.

params.name: string
params.description: The string that replaces the selected text

methods.name: ReselectRow
methods.documentation: Accesses the database to retrieve values for all columns that can be updated and refreshes all timestamp columns in a row in a DataWindow control or DataStore. The values from the database are redisplayed in the row.

params.name: row
params.description: A value identifying the row to reselect

methods.name: Reset
methods.documentation: Clears all the data from a DataWindow control or DataStore object. For the syntax to use for deleting graphs within a DataWindow object that have an external data source, see Reset . For the syntax to use with other PowerBuilder controls, see the section called “Reset” in PowerScript Reference .

methods.name: ResetDataColors
methods.documentation: Restores the color of a data point to the default color for its series.
methods.syntax: integer dwcontrol.ResetDataColors ( string graphcontrol, integer seriesnumber, long datapointnumber )

params.name: graphcontrol
params.description: A string whose value is the name of the graph in the DataWindow control

params.name: seriesnumber
params.description: The number of the series in which you want to reset the color of a data point

params.name: datapointnumber
params.description: The number of the data point for which you want to reset the color

methods.name: ResetInk
methods.documentation: Clears ink from an InkPicture control in a DataWindow.
methods.syntax: integer dwcontrol.ResetInk ( string name, long rownumber )

params.name: name
params.description: The name of the InkPicture control from which you want to clear the picture.

params.name: rownumber
params.description: The number of the row that contains the picture to be cleared. To clear all rows, set rownumber to 0.

methods.name: ResetTransObject
methods.documentation: Stops a DataWindow control or DataStore from using the programmer-specified transaction object that is currently in effect through a call to the SetTransObject method. After you call the ResetTransObject method, the DataWindow control or DataStore uses its internal transaction object.

methods.name: ResetUpdate
methods.documentation: Clears the update flags in the primary and filter buffers and empties the delete buffer of a DataWindow or DataStore.

methods.name: Resize
methods.documentation: Resizes an object or control by setting its Width and Height properties and then redraws the object.

params.name: width
params.description: The new width in PowerBuilder units

params.name: height
params.description: The new height in PowerBuilder units

methods.name: Retrieve
methods.documentation: Retrieves rows from the database for a DataWindow control or DataStore. If arguments are included, the argument values are used for the retrieval arguments in the SQL SELECT statement for the DataWindow object or child DataWindow.
methods.syntax: long dwcontrol.Retrieve ( { any argument, any argument . . . } )

params.name: argument
params.description: One or more values that you want to use as retrieval arguments in the SQL SELECT statement defined in dwcontrol.

methods.name: RowCount
methods.documentation: Obtains the number of rows that are currently available in a DataWindow control or DataStore. To determine the number of rows available, the RowCount method checks the primary buffer.

methods.name: RowsCopy
methods.documentation: Copies a range of rows from one DataWindow control (or DataStore object) to another, or from one buffer to another within a single DataWindow control (or DataStore).
methods.syntax: integer dwcontrol.RowsCopy ( long startrow, long endrow, DWBuffer copybuffer, datawindow targetdw, long beforerow, DWBuffer targetbuffer) integer dwcontrol.RowsCopy ( long startrow, long endrow, DWBuffer copybuffer, datastore targetdw, long beforerow, DWBuffer targetbuffer ) integer dwcontrol.RowsCopy ( long startrow, long endrow, DWBuffer copybuffer, datawindowchild targetdw, long beforerow, DWBuffer targetbuffer )

params.name: startrow
params.description: The number of the first row you want to copy.

params.name: endrow
params.description: The number of the last row you want to copy.

params.name: copybuffer
params.description: A value of the dwBuffer enumerated datatype identifying the DataWindow buffer from which you want to copy rows. For a list of valid values, see DWBuffer .

params.name: targetdw
params.description: A reference to the DataWindow control or DataStore object to which you want to copy the rows. Targetdw can be the same DataWindow (or DataStore) or another DataWindow (or DataStore).

params.name: beforerow
params.description: The number of the row before which you want to insert the copied rows. To insert after the last row, use any value that is greater than the number of existing rows.

params.name: targetbuffer
params.description: A value of the dwBuffer enumerated datatype identifying the target DataWindow buffer for the copied rows. For a list of valid values, see DWBuffer .

methods.name: RowsDiscard
methods.documentation: Discards a range of rows in a DataWindow control. Once a row has been discarded using RowsDiscard, you cannot restore the row. You have to retrieve it again from the database.
methods.syntax: integer dwcontrol.RowsDiscard (long startrow, long endrow, DWBuffer buffer )

params.name: startrow
params.description: The number of the first row you want to discard.

params.name: endrow
params.description: The number of the last row you want to discard.

params.name: buffer
params.description: A value of the dwBuffer enumerated datatype specifying the DataWindow buffer containing the rows to be discarded. For a list of valid values, see DWBuffer .

methods.name: RowsMove
methods.documentation: Clears a range of rows from one DataWindow control (or DataStore) and inserts them in another. Alternatively, RowsMove moves rows from one buffer to another within a single DataWindow control (or DataStore).
methods.syntax: integer dwcontrol.RowsMove ( long startrow, long endrow, DWBuffer movebuffer, datawindow targetdw, long beforerow, DWBuffer targetbuffer ) integer dwcontrol.RowsMove ( long startrow, long endrow, DWBuffer movebuffer, datastore targetdw, long beforerow, DWBuffer targetbuffer ) integer dwcontrol.RowsMove ( long startrow, long endrow, DWBuffer movebuffer, datawindowchild targetdw, long beforerow, DWBuffer targetbuffer )

params.name: startrow
params.description: The number of the first row you want to move.

params.name: endrow
params.description: The number of the last row you want to move.

params.name: movebuffer
params.description: A value of the dwBuffer enumerated datatype identifying the DataWindow buffer from which you want to move the rows. For a list of valid values, see DWBuffer .

params.name: targetdw
params.description: The name of the DataWindow control or DataStore to which you want to move the rows. Targetdw can be the same DataWindow control (or DataStore) or a different DataWindow control (or DataStore), but it cannot be a child DataWindow.

params.name: beforerow
params.description: The number of the row before which you want to insert the moved rows. To insert after the last row, use any value that is greater than the number of existing rows.

params.name: targetbuffer
params.description: A value of the dwBuffer enumerated datatype identifying the target buffer for the rows. For a list of valid values, see DWBuffer .

methods.name: SaveAs
methods.documentation: Saves the contents of a DataWindow or DataStore in the format you specify. For syntax to save the contents of graphs in DataWindows and DataStores, see SaveAs . For syntax to save objects in OLE controls and OLE storage, see SaveAs in PowerScript Reference .
methods.syntax: integer dwcontrol.SaveAs ( { string filename, saveastype saveastype, boolean colheading { , encoding encoding } } )

params.name: filename
params.description: A string whose value is the name of the file in which to save the contents. If you omit this argument, or specify an empty string ("") for filename but include valid values for the saveastype and colheading arguments, the DataWindow prompts end users for a file name. Working with DataStore objects If you are working with a DataStore, you must supply the filename argument.

params.name: saveastype
params.description: A value of the SaveAsType enumerated datatype specifying the format in which to save the contents of the DataWindow object. For a list of values, see SaveAsType .

params.name: colheading
params.description: A boolean value indicating whether you want to include the DataWindow's column headings at the beginning of the file. The default value is true. This argument is used for the following formats: Clipboard, CSV, Excel, and Text. For most other formats, column headings are always saved.

params.name: encoding
params.description: Character encoding of the file to which the data is saved. This parameter applies only to the following formats: TEXT, CSV, SQL, HTML, and DIF. If you do not specify an encoding parameter, the file is saved in ANSI format. Values are: EncodingANSI! (default) EncodingUTF8! EncodingUTF16LE! EncodingUTF16BE!

methods.name: SaveAsAscii
methods.documentation: Saves the contents of a DataWindow or DataStore into a standard ANSI text file.
methods.syntax: long dwcontrol.SaveAsAscii ( string filename {, string separatorcharacter {,string quotecharacter {, string lineending {, boolean retainnewlinechar } } } } )

params.name: filename
params.description: A string whose value is the name of the file in which to save the contents.

params.name: separatorcharacter
params.description: A string whose value is the character to be used to delimit values. If you omit separatorcharacter, the default is a tab character.

params.name: quotecharacter
params.description: A string whose value is the character to be used to wrap values. If you omit quotecharacter, the default is double quote.

params.name: lineending
params.description: A string whose value is placed at the end of each line. If you omit lineending, the default is a carriage return plus a newline character (~r~n).

params.name: retainnewlinechar
params.description: A boolean value that determines whether line feed and carriage return characters contained within the row are converted to white space. Values are: True -- line feed and carriage return characters within the row are not converted to white space False (default) -- line feed and carriage return characters within the row are converted to white space

methods.name: SaveAsFormattedText
methods.documentation: Saves the contents of a DataWindow or DataStore into a standard text file with custom formatting.
methods.syntax: long dwcontrol.SaveAsFormattedText ( string filename {, string encoding {, string separatorcharacter {,string quotecharacter {, string lineending {, boolean retainnewlinechar } } } } )

params.name: filename
params.description: A string whose value is the name of the file in which to save the contents.

params.name: encoding
params.description: Character encoding of the file to which the data is saved. If you do not specify an encoding parameter, the file is saved in ANSI format. Values are: EncodingANSI! (default) EncodingUTF8! EncodingUTF16LE! EncodingUTF16BE!

params.name: separatorcharacter
params.description: A string whose value is the character to be used to delimit values. If you omit separatorcharacter, the default is a tab character.

params.name: quotecharacter
params.description: A string whose value is the character to be used to wrap values. If you omit quotecharacter, the default is double quote.

params.name: lineending
params.description: A string whose value is placed at the end of each line. If you omit lineending, the default is a carriage return plus a newline character (~r~n).

params.name: retainnewlinechar
params.description: A boolean value that determines whether line feed and carriage return characters contained within the row are converted to white space. Values are: True -- line feed and carriage return characters within the row are not converted to white space False (default) -- line feed and carriage return characters within the row are converted to white space

methods.name: SaveInk
methods.documentation: Saves overlay ink to a file or blob from an InkPicture control.
methods.syntax: integer dwcontrol.SaveInk ( string name, long rownumber, blob blob ) integer dwcontrol.SaveInk ( string name, long rownumber, string filename {, inkpersistenceformat format {, inkcompressionmode mode } } )

params.name: name
params.description: The name of the InkPicture control from which you want to save the ink.

params.name: rownumber
params.description: The number of the row that contains the ink to be saved.

params.name: blob
params.description: The name of a blob passed by reference that will hold the ink in the control.

params.name: filename
params.description: A string containing the name and location of a file that will hold the ink in the control.

params.name: format
params.description: A value of the InkPersistenceFormat enumerated variable that specifies the format in which you want to save the ink. Values are: Base64GIFFormat! Base64InkSerializedFormat! GIFFormat! InkSerializedFormat! (default)

params.name: mode
params.description: A value of the InkCompressionMode enumerated variable that specifies the compression mode in which you want to save the ink. Values are: DefaultCompression! (default) MaximumCompression! NoCompression!

methods.name: SaveInkPic
methods.documentation: Saves a picture and optionally overlay ink to a file from an InkPicture control.
methods.syntax: integer dwcontrol.SaveInkPic ( string name, long rownumber, string filename , integer format {, boolean withink } )

params.name: name
params.description: The name of the InkPicture control from which you want to save the picture.

params.name: rownumber
params.description: The number of the row that contains the picture to be saved.

params.name: filename
params.description: A string containing the name and location of a file that will hold the picture in the control.

params.name: format
params.description: An integer specifying the format in which the picture is to be saved. Values are: 0 -- BMP (bitmap) 1 -- JPEG (Joint Photographic Experts Group) 2 -- GIF (Graphics Interchange Format) 3 -- TIFF (Tagged Image File Format) 4 -- PNG (Portable Network Graphics)

params.name: withink
params.description: A boolean specifying whether overlay ink should be saved with the picture. Values are: True -- overlay ink is saved with the picture (default) False -- overlay ink is not saved with the picture

methods.name: SaveNativePDFToBlob
methods.documentation: Saves the PDF file into a blob variable when you use the PDFlib method to save data from a DataWindow object to a PDF file.

params.name: data
params.description: A blob variable into which the PDF file will be saved.

methods.name: Scroll
methods.documentation: Scrolls the edit control of a DataWindow a specified number of lines up or down.

params.name: number
params.description: A value specifying the direction and number of lines you want to scroll. To scroll down, use a positive value. To scroll up, use a negative value.

methods.name: ScrollFirstPage
methods.documentation: Scrolls a Web DataWindow control to the first page, displaying the result set's first group of rows in the Web page. (A page is the number of rows that are displayed in the DataWindow control at one time.) ScrollFirstPage changes the current row, but not the current column.

methods.name: ScrollLastPage
methods.documentation: Scrolls a Web DataWindow control to the last page, displaying the result set's last group of rows in the Web page. (A page is the number of rows that are displayed in the DataWindow control at one time.) ScrollLastPage changes the current row, but not the current column.

methods.name: ScrollToRow
methods.documentation: Scrolls a DataWindow control to the specified row. ScrollToRow changes the current row but not the current column.

params.name: row
params.description: A value identifying the row to which you want to scroll. If row is 0, ScrollToRow scrolls to the first row. If row is greater than the last row number, it scrolls to the last row. If row is visible without scrolling, the DataWindow does not scroll.

methods.name: SelectedLength
methods.documentation: Determines the total number of characters in the selected text in an edit control, including spaces and line endings.

methods.name: SelectedLine
methods.documentation: Obtains the number of the line that contains the insertion point in an editable control.

methods.name: SelectedStart
methods.documentation: Reports the position of the first selected character in the edit control.

methods.name: SelectedText
methods.documentation: Obtains the selected text in the edit control of a DataWindow control.

methods.name: SelectRow
methods.documentation: Highlights or removes highlights from rows in a DataWindow control or DataStore. You can select all rows or a single row. SelectRow does not affect which row is current. It does not select rows in the database.
methods.syntax: integer dwcontrol.SelectRow ( long row, boolean select )

params.name: row
params.description: A value identifying the row you want to select or deselect. Specify 0 to select or deselect all rows.

params.name: select
params.description: A boolean value that determines whether the row is selected or not selected: True -- Select the row(s) so that they are highlighted. False -- Deselect the row(s) so that they are not highlighted.

methods.name: SelectTextAll
methods.documentation: Selects all the contents of a RichTextEdit control including any special characters such as carriage return and end-of-file markers.

params.name: band
params.description: A value of the Band enumerated datatype specifying the band in which you want to select all the text. Values are: Detail! Header! Footer! The default is the band that contains the insertion point.

methods.name: SelectTextLine
methods.documentation: Selects the line containing the insertion point in a RichTextEdit control.

methods.name: SelectTextWord
methods.documentation: Selects the word containing the insertion point in a RichTextEdit control.

methods.name: SelectTreeNode
methods.documentation: Selects or deselects a TreeView node in a TreeView DataWindow.
methods.syntax: Integer dw_control.SelectTreeNode(long row, long groupLevel, boolean bSelect)

params.name: row
params.description: The number of the row that belongs to the group

params.name: groupLevel
params.description: The TreeView level of the group

params.name: bSelect
params.description: Indicates whether the TreeView node is selected or not

methods.name: SeriesCount
methods.documentation: Counts the number of series in a graph.

params.name: graphcontrol
params.description: A string whose value is the name of the graph in the DataWindow control

methods.name: SeriesName
methods.documentation: Obtains the series name associated with the specified series number.
methods.syntax: integer dwcontrol.SeriesName ( string graphcontrol, integer seriesnumber )

params.name: graphcontrol
params.description: A string whose value is the name of the graph in the DataWindow control

params.name: seriesnumber
params.description: The number of the series for which you want to obtain the name

methods.name: SetAction
methods.documentation: Accepts action and context information about user interaction with the Web DataWindow client control in a Web browser so that generated HTML reflects any requested changes.

methods.name: SetActionCode
methods.documentation: Sets the action code for an event in a DataWindow control. The action code determines the action that PowerBuilder takes following the event. The default action code is 0.

params.name: code
params.description: A value specifying the action you want to take in the DataWindow control. The meaning of the action code depends on the event.

methods.name: SetBorderStyle
methods.documentation: Sets the border style of a column in a DataWindow control or DataStore.
methods.syntax: integer dwcontrol.SetBorderStyle ( integer column, border borderstyle ) integer dwcontrol.SetBorderStyle ( string column, border borderstyle )

params.name: column
params.description: The column in which you want to change the border style. Column can be a column number or a column name.

params.name: borderstyle
params.description: A value of the Border enumerated datatype identifying the border style you want to use for the column. For a list of valid values, see Border .

methods.name: SetBrowser
methods.documentation: Specifies the Web browser for which you want to generate optimized HTML.

methods.name: SetChanges
methods.documentation: Applies changes captured with GetChanges to a DataWindow or DataStore. This method is used primarily in distributed applications.
methods.syntax: long dwcontrol.SetChanges ( blob changeblob {, dwConflictResolution resolution } )

params.name: changeblob
params.description: A read-only change blob created with GetChanges from which you want to apply changes.

params.name: resolution
params.description: A value of the dwConflictResolution enumerated datatype indicating how conflicts should be resolved: FailOnAnyConflict! (default) AllowPartialChanges! This argument is obsolete and will be disabled in a future release.

methods.name: SetColumn
methods.documentation: Sets the current column in a DataWindow control or DataStore.
methods.syntax: integer dwcontrol.SetColumn ( string column) integer dwcontrol.SetColumn ( integer column)

params.name: column
params.description: The column you want to make current. Column can be a column number or a column name.

methods.name: SetColumnLink
methods.documentation: Specifies information used for constructing hyperlinks for data in a column in generated HTML.

methods.name: SetCultureFormat
methods.documentation: The culture format set by this function does not affect the DataWindow display. It is used only for rendering HTML, XHTML, and XML for the DataWindow control.

params.name: cultureStr
params.description: A string that defines the formats for displaying information. For example: sDecimal=, sTime=: sThousand= sShortDate=dd/MM/yyyy iDate=1 sDate=/ sLongDate=dddd d MMMM yyyy sCurrency=' iCurrDigits=2 iNegCurr=8 iCurrency=3 iMeasure=0 iTime=1 sDecimal is the symbol used to indicate the decimal place. sTime is the symbol used to separate the hours and minutes in time displays. sThousand is Each definition is delimited by a tab.

methods.name: SetDataLabelling
methods.documentation: Set the data label for a DirectX 3D graph.
methods.syntax: integer dwcontrol.SetDataLabelling (string graphcontrol, int seriesnumber, int datapoint, boolean value)

params.name: graphcontrol
params.description: A string whose value is the name of the graph in the DataWindow control.

params.name: seriesnumber
params.description: The number that identifies the series in which you want to set the data labelling value.

params.name: datapoint
params.description: The datapoint.

params.name: value
params.description: Indicates whether to label the data with its value.

methods.name: SetDataPieExplode
methods.documentation: Explodes a pie slice in a pie graph. The exploded slice is moved away from the center of the pie, which draws attention to the data. You can explode any number of slices of the pie.
methods.syntax: integer dwcontrol.SetDataPieExplode ( string graphcontrol, integer seriesnumber, integer datapoint, integer percentage )

params.name: graphcontrol
params.description: A string whose value is the name of the graph in the DataWindow control.

params.name: seriesnumber
params.description: The number that identifies the series.

params.name: datapoint
params.description: The number of the data point (that is, the pie slice) to be exploded.

params.name: percentage
params.description: A number between 0 and 100 that is the percentage of the radius that the pie slice is moved away from the center. When percentage is 100, the tip of the slice is even with the circumference of the pie's circle.

methods.name: SetDataTransparency
methods.documentation: Sets the transparency percentage for a data point in a series in a DirectX 3D graph.
methods.syntax: integer dwcontrol.SetDataTransparency ( string graphcontrol, integer seriesnumber, int datapoint, int transparency)

params.name: graphcontrol
params.description: A string whose value is the name of the graph in the DataWindow control.

params.name: seriesnumber
params.description: The number that identifies the series in which you want to set the transparency value of a data point.

params.name: datapoint
params.description: The number of the data point for which you want to set a transparency value.

params.name: transparency
params.description: Integer value for percent transparency. A value of 0 means that the data point is opaque and a value of 100 means that it is completely transparent.

methods.name: SetDetailHeight
methods.documentation: Sets the height of each row in the specified range to the specified value.
methods.syntax: integer dwcontrol.SetDetailHeight ( long startrow, long endrow , long height )

params.name: startrow
params.description: The first row in the range of rows for which you want to set the height

params.name: endrow
params.description: The last row in the range of rows for which you want to set the height

params.name: height
params.description: The height of the detail area for the specified rows in the units specified for the DataWindow object

methods.name: SetDWObject
methods.documentation: Specifies the DataWindow library and object that the Web DataWindow server component will use for generating HTML.

methods.name: SetFilter
methods.documentation: Specifies filter criteria for a DataWindow control or DataStore.

params.name: format
params.description: A string whose value is a boolean expression that you want to use as the filter criteria. The expression includes column names or numbers. A column number must be preceded by a pound sign (#). If format is null, PowerBuilder prompts you to enter a filter.

methods.name: SetFormat
methods.documentation: Specifies a display format for a column in a DataWindow control or DataStore.
methods.syntax: integer dwcontrol.SetFormat ( string column, string format ) integer dwcontrol.SetFormat ( integer column, string format )

params.name: column
params.description: The column for which you are specifying the display format. Column can be a column number or a column name.

params.name: format
params.description: A string whose value is the display format for the DataWindow column.

methods.name: SetFullState
methods.documentation: Applies the contents of a DataWindow blob retrieved by GetFullState to a DataWindow or DataStore. This method is used primarily in distributed applications.

params.name: dwasblob
params.description: A blob that contains the state information you want to apply to the DataWindow control or DataStore

methods.name: SetHTMLAction
methods.documentation: Accepts action and context information about user interaction with the Web DataWindow client control in a Web browser so that newly generated HTML can reflect any requested changes.
methods.syntax: integer dwcontrol.SetHTMLAction ( string action, string context )

params.name: action
params.description: A string describing an action associated with a button click or method call in a Web DataWindow client control on a Web page. The value is stored in a page parameter called HTMLGenObjectName_action. action must be a valid action and cannot be an empty string or the value none.

params.name: context
params.description: A string describing the context of action in the Web DataWindow client control. The string is generated by a Web DataWindow script and the value is stored in a page parameter called HTMLGenObjectName_context. The format is not documented and subject to change.

methods.name: SetHTMLObjectName
methods.documentation: Specifies a name for the Web DataWindow client control.

methods.name: SetItem
methods.documentation: Sets the value of a row and column in a DataWindow control or DataStore to the specified value.
methods.syntax: integer dwcontrol.SetItem ( long row, integer column, any value ) integer dwcontrol.SetItem ( long row, string column, any value )

params.name: row
params.description: The row location of the data.

params.name: column
params.description: The column location of the data. Column can be a column number or a column name. The column number is the number of the column as it is listed in the Column Specification view of the DataWindow painter -- not necessarily the number of the column in the Design view.

params.name: value
params.description: The value to which you want to set the data at the row and column location. The datatype of the value must be the same datatype as the column.

methods.name: SetItemDate
methods.documentation: Sets the value of a row and column in a DataWindow control to the specified value.

methods.name: SetItemDateTime
methods.documentation: Sets the value of a row and column in a DataWindow control to the specified value.

methods.name: SetItemNumber
methods.documentation: Sets the value of a row and column in a DataWindow control to the specified value.

methods.name: SetItemStatus
methods.documentation: Changes the modification status of a row or a column within a row. The modification status determines the type of SQL statement the Update method will generate for the row.
methods.syntax: integer dwcontrol.SetItemStatus ( long row, integer column, dwbuffer dwbuffer, dwitemstatus status ) integer dwcontrol.SetItemStatus ( long row, string column, dwbuffer dwbuffer, dwitemstatus status )

params.name: row
params.description: The row location in which you want to set the status.

params.name: column
params.description: The column location in which you want to set the status. Column can be a column number or a column name. To set the status for the row, enter 0 for column.

params.name: dwbuffer
params.description: A value identifying the DataWindow buffer that contains the row. For a list of valid values, see DWBuffer .

params.name: status
params.description: A value of the dwItemStatus enumerated datatype specifying the new status. For a list of valid values, see DWItemStatus .

methods.name: SetItemString
methods.documentation: Sets the value of a row and column in a DataWindow control to the specified value.

methods.name: SetItemTime
methods.documentation: Sets the value of a row and column in a DataWindow control to the specified value.

methods.name: SetPageSize
methods.documentation: Specifies the number of rows to include in a generated Web page for the Web DataWindow.

methods.name: SetPosition
methods.documentation: Moves a control within the DataWindow to another band or changes the front-to-back order of controls within a band.
methods.syntax: integer dwcontrol.SetPosition ( string controlname, string band, boolean bringtofront )

params.name: controlname
params.description: The name of the control within the DataWindow that you want to move. You assign names to the controls in the DataWindow painter.

params.name: band
params.description: A string whose value is the name of the band or layer in which you want to position controlname. Layer names are background and foreground. Band names are detail, header, footer, summary, header.#, and trailer.#, where # is the group level number. Enter the empty string ("") if you do not want to change the band.

params.name: bringtofront
params.description: A boolean indicating whether you want to bring controlname to the front within the band: True -- Bring it to the front. False -- Do not bring it to the front.

methods.name: SetRedraw
methods.documentation: Controls the automatic redrawing of an object or control after each change to its properties.

params.name: redraw
params.description: A boolean value that controls whether PowerBuilder redraws an object automatically after a change. Values are: True -- Automatically redraw the object or control after each change to its properties. False -- Do not redraw after each change.

methods.name: SetRichTextAlign
methods.documentation: Sets the alignment value to use while editing columns with the RichText edit style.

params.name: sAlign
params.description: Value for specifying the alignment that you want to set for columns with the RichText edit style. Allowable values are: Left! Right! Center! Justified!

methods.name: SetRichTextColor
methods.documentation: Sets the color to use while editing columns with the RichText edit style.

params.name: color
params.description: A long value specifying the color that you want to set for editing columns with the RichText edit style

methods.name: SetRichTextFaceName
methods.documentation: Sets the typeface to use while editing columns with the RichText edit style.

params.name: typeface
params.description: A string value for the typeface that you want to set for editing columns with the RichText edit style

methods.name: SetRichTextSize
methods.documentation: Sets the size of the font to use while editing columns with the RichText edit style.

params.name: size
params.description: A long value for the point size of the font that you want to set for editing columns with the RichText edit style

methods.name: SetRichTextStyle
methods.documentation: Sets the style of the font to use while editing columns with the RichText edit style.
methods.syntax: Integer dwcontrol.SetRichTextStyle ( boolean bold, boolean underline, boolean italic, boolean strikeout, )

params.name: bold
params.description: A boolean for the bold style

params.name: underline
params.description: A boolean for the underlined style

params.name: italic
params.description: A boolean for the italic style

params.name: strikeout
params.description: A boolean for the strikeout style

methods.name: SetRow
methods.documentation: Sets the current row in a DataWindow control or DataStore.

params.name: row
params.description: The row you want to make current

methods.name: SetRowFocusIndicator
methods.documentation: Specifies the visual indicator that identifies the current row in the DataWindow control. You can use the standard dotted-line rectangle of Windows, PowerBuilder's pointing hand, or an image stored in a PowerBuilder Picture control.
methods.syntax: integer dwcontrol.SetRowFocusIndicator ( RowFocusInd focusindicator {, integer xlocation {, integer ylocation } } ) integer dwcontrol.SetRowFocusIndicator ( Picture picturename {, integer xlocation {, integer ylocation } } )

params.name: focusindicator
params.description: The visual indicator for the current row. In PowerBuilder, a value of the RowFocusInd enumerated datatype or the name of a PowerBuilder Picture control whose image you want to use. For a list of valid enumerated datatype values, see RowFocusInd .

params.name: xlocation
params.description: The x coordinate in PowerBuilder units of the position of the hand or bitmap relative to the upper-left corner of the row.

params.name: ylocation
params.description: The y coordinate in PowerBuilder units of the position of the hand or bitmap relative to the upper-left corner of the row.

methods.name: SetSelfLink
methods.documentation: Specifies the URL and page parameters for the current page of the Web DataWindow.

methods.name: SetSeriesLabelling
methods.documentation: Set the series label for a DirectX 3D graph.
methods.syntax: integer dwcontrol.SetSeriesLabelling (string graphcontrol, string series, boolean value)

params.name: graphcontrol
params.description: A string whose value is the name of the graph in the DataWindow control.

params.name: series
params.description: The string that names the series in which you want to change the series label setting.

params.name: value
params.description: Indicates whether to label the series with its values.

methods.name: SetSeriesTransparency
methods.documentation: Sets the transparency percentage of a series in a DirectX 3D type graph.
methods.syntax: integer dwcontrol.SetSeriesTransparency ( string graphcontrol, stringseries, int transparency)

params.name: graphcontrol
params.description: A string whose value is the name of the graph in the DataWindow control.

params.name: series
params.description: The string that identifies the series in which you want to set the transparency value.

params.name: transparency
params.description: Integer value for percentage transparency. A value of 0 means that the series is opaque and a value of 100 means that it is completely transparent.

methods.name: SetServerServiceClasses
methods.documentation: Tells the server component to trigger custom events defined in user objects for data validation. These user objects, referred to as service classes, must be defined in the PBL or PBD containing the DataWindow object for the server component.

methods.name: SetServerSideState
methods.documentation: Tells the server component whether to attempt to maintain its state by saving the retrieved data and leaving the transaction open. Keeping the retrieved data means that the component does not need to reconnect and retrieve data every time a method is called.

methods.name: SetSort
methods.documentation: Specifies sort criteria for a DataWindow control or DataStore.

params.name: format
params.description: A string whose value is valid sort criteria for the DataWindow (see Usage). The expression includes column names or numbers. A column number must be preceded by a pound sign (#). If format is null, PowerBuilder prompts you to enter the sort criteria.

methods.name: SetSQLPreview
methods.documentation: Specifies the SQL statement for a DataWindow control or DataStore that PowerBuilder is about to send to the database.

params.name: sqlsyntax
params.description: A string whose value is valid SQL syntax for the SQL statement that will be submitted to the database server

methods.name: SetSQLSelect
methods.documentation: Specifies the SQL SELECT statement for a DataWindow control or DataStore.

params.name: statement
params.description: A string whose value is the SELECT statement for the DataWindow object. The statement must structurally match the current SELECT statement (that is, it must return the same number of columns, the columns must be the same datatype, and the columns must be in the same order).

methods.name: SetTabOrder
methods.documentation: Changes the tab sequence number of a column in a DataWindow control to the specified value.
methods.syntax: integer dwcontrol.SetTabOrder ( integer column, integer tabnumber ) integer dwcontrol.SetTabOrder ( string column, integer tabnumber )

params.name: column
params.description: The column to which you are assigning a tab value. Column can be a column number or a column name. The column number is the number of the column as it is listed in the Column Specification view of the DataWindow painter -- not necessarily the number of the column in the Design view.

params.name: tabnumber
params.description: The tab sequence number (0 - 9999) you want to assign to the DataWindow column. 0 removes the column from the tab order, which makes it read-only.

methods.name: SetText
methods.documentation: Replaces the text in the edit control over the current row and column in a DataWindow control or DataStore.

params.name: text
params.description: A string whose value you want to put in the current row and column. The value must be compatible with the datatype of the column.

methods.name: SetTrans
methods.documentation: Sets the values in the internal transaction object for a DataWindow control or DataStore to the values from the specified transaction object. The transaction object supplies connection settings, such as the database name.

params.name: transaction
params.description: The name of the transaction object from which you want dwcontrol to get values

methods.name: SetTransObject
methods.documentation: Causes a DataWindow control or DataStore to use a programmer-specified transaction object. The transaction object provides the information necessary for communicating with the database.

params.name: transaction
params.description: The name of the transaction object you want to use in the dwcontrol

methods.name: SetValidate
methods.documentation: Sets the input validation rule for a column in a DataWindow control or DataStore.
methods.syntax: integer dwcontrol.SetValidate ( string column, string rule ) integer dwcontrol.SetValidate ( integer column, string rule )

params.name: column
params.description: The column for which you want to set the input validation rule. Column can be a column number or a column name.

params.name: rule
params.description: A string whose value is the validation rule for validating the data.

methods.name: SetValue
methods.documentation: Sets the value of an item in a value list or code table for a column in a DataWindow control or DataStore. (A value list is called a code table when it has both display and data values.) SetValue does not affect the data stored in the column.
methods.syntax: integer dwcontrol.SetValue ( string column, integer index, string value ) integer dwcontrol.SetValue ( integer column, integer index, string value )

params.name: column
params.description: The column that contains the value list or code table. Column can be a column number or a column name. The edit style of the column can be DropDownListBox, Edit, or RadioButton. SetValue has no effect when column has the EditMask or DropDownDataWindow edit style.

params.name: index
params.description: The number of the item in the value list or code table for which you want to set the value.

params.name: value
params.description: A string whose value is the new value for the item. For a code table, use a tab (~t in PowerBuilder) to separate the display value from the data value ("Texas~tTX"). The data value must be a string that can be converted to the datatype of the column.

methods.name: SetWeight
methods.documentation: Specifies the types of JavaScript code that will be included in the generated HTML or XHTML.
methods.syntax: integer dwcomponent.SetWeight ( boolean allowupdate, boolean validation, boolean events, boolean clientscriptable, boolean clientformatting )

params.name: allowupdate
params.description: Specifies whether the generated HTML will be a form with INPUT elements so that the user can change the data. Values are: True -- The generated HTML is a form. The user can change the data. False -- The generated HTML is a table. The user cannot change the data. When allowupdate is false, validation and clientformatting are ignored and no validation or formatting scripts are generated.

params.name: validation
params.description: Specifies whether the generated HTML will include scripts for validating data the user enters. The scripts implement validation rules defined in the DataWindow object. Values are: True -- The generated HTML has scripts that implement validation rules. False -- The generated HTML does not validate user-entered data. Sets the value of the HTMLGen.ClientValidation property for the DataWindow object associated with the server component.

params.name: events
params.description: Specifies whether the generated HTML will include code for triggering events. Values are: True -- The generated HTML has scripts that trigger events. False -- The generated HTML does not trigger events. Sets the value of the HTMLGen.ClientEvents property for the DataWindow object associated with the server component. The available events are listed in the DataWindow event cross-reference .

params.name: clientscriptable
params.description: Specifies whether the generated HTML allows client-side scripts to call methods of the client control. Values are: True -- The generated HTML includes methods that the client scripts can call. False -- The generated HTML does not include methods. This option adds approximately 100K to the generated HTML. Sets the value of the HTMLGen.ClientScriptable property for the DataWindow object associated with the server component.

params.name: clientformatting
params.description: Specifies whether the generated HTML will include scripts for formatting data the user enters. The scripts implement display formats defined in the DataWindow object. Values are: True -- The generated HTML has scripts that format user-entered data. False -- The generated HTML does not format user-entered data. Sets the value of the HTMLGen.ClientFormatting property for the DataWindow object associated with the server component.

methods.name: ShareData
methods.documentation: Shares data retrieved by one DataWindow control (or DataStore), which is referred to as the primary DataWindow, with another DataWindow control (or DataStore), referred to as the secondary DataWindow. The controls do not share formatting; only the data is shared, including data in the primary buffer, the delete buffer, the filter buffer, and the sort order. Note If you are using ShareData and then use ReselectRow on the primary DataWindow, the secondary DataWindow resets back to row 1, column 1.
methods.syntax: integer dwprimary.ShareData ( datawindow dwsecondary ) integer dwprimary.ShareData ( datastore dwsecondary ) integer dwprimary.ShareData ( datawindowchild dwsecondary )

params.name: dwsecondary
params.description: The name of the secondary DataWindow with which the control dwprimary will share the data. The secondary DataWindow can be a child DataWindow or a report in a composite DataWindow object but it cannot be a Crosstab DataWindow object.

methods.name: ShareDataOff
methods.documentation: Turns off the sharing of data buffers for a DataWindow control or DataStore.

methods.name: Show
methods.documentation: Makes an object or control visible, if it is hidden. If the object is already visible, Show brings it to the top.

methods.name: ShowHeadFoot
methods.documentation: Displays the panels for editing the header and footer in a RichTextEdit control or hides the panels and returns to editing the main text.

params.name: editheadfoot
params.description: A boolean value specifying the editing panel to display. Values are: True -- Display the header and footer editing panels. False -- Display the detail editing panel for the document body.

params.name: headerfooter
params.description: A boolean value specifying whether the insertion point (caret) for editing the header/footer panel is in the header or the footer section. Values are: True Caret is in the header section. False Caret is in the footer section.

methods.name: Sort
methods.documentation: Sorts the rows in a DataWindow control or DataStore using the DataWindow's current sort criteria.

methods.name: TextLine
methods.documentation: Obtains the text of the line that contains the insertion point. TextLine works for controls that can contain multiple lines.

methods.name: TriggerEvent
methods.documentation: Triggers an event associated with the specified object, which executes the script for that event immediately.
methods.syntax: integer objectname.TriggerEvent ( trigevent event {, long word, long long } ) integer objectname.TriggerEvent ( trigevent event {, long word, string long } )

params.name: event
params.description: A value of the TrigEvent enumerated datatype that identifies a PowerBuilder event (for example, Clicked!, Modified!, or DoubleClicked!) or a string whose value is the name of an event. The event must be a valid event for objectname and a script must exist for the event in objectname.

params.name: word
params.description: A value to be stored in the WordParm property of the system's Message object. If you want to specify a value for long, but not word, enter 0. (For cross-platform compatibility, WordParm and LongParm are both longs.)

params.name: long
params.description: A value or a string that you want to store in the LongParm property of the system's Message object. When you specify a string, a pointer to the string is stored in the LongParm property, which you can access with the String function (see Usage).

methods.name: TypeOf
methods.documentation: Determines the type of an object or control, reported as a value of the Object enumerated datatype.

methods.name: Undo
methods.documentation: Cancels the last edit in an edit control, restoring the text to the content before the last change.

methods.name: Update
methods.documentation: Updates the database with the changes made in a DataWindow control or DataStore. Update can also call AcceptText for the current row and column before it updates the database.
methods.syntax: integer dwcontrol.Update ( { boolean accept {, boolean resetflag } } )

params.name: accept
params.description: A boolean value specifying whether the DataWindow control or DataStore should automatically perform an AcceptText prior to performing the update: True -- (Default) Perform AcceptText. The update is canceled if the data fails validation. False -- Do not perform AcceptText.

params.name: resetflag
params.description: A boolean value specifying whether dwcontrol should automatically reset the update flags: True -- (Default) Reset the flags. False -- Do not reset the flags.

events.name: BackTabOut
events.documentation: Occurs when the user presses Shift+Tab or, in some edit styles, the left arrow, to move focus to the prior control in the Window or user object.

events.name: ButtonClicked
events.documentation: Occurs when the user clicks a button inside a DataWindow object.

events.name: ButtonClicking
events.documentation: Occurs when the user clicks a button. This event occurs before the ButtonClicked event.

events.name: Clicked
events.documentation: Occurs when the user clicks anywhere in a DataWindow control.

events.name: Collapsed
events.documentation: Occurs when a node in a TreeView DataWindow has collapsed.

events.name: Collapsing
events.documentation: Occurs before a node in a TreeView DataWindow collapses.

events.name: Constructor
events.documentation: Occurs when the DataWindow control or DataStore object is created, just before the Open event for the window that contains the control.

events.name: DBError
events.documentation: Occurs when a database error occurs in the DataWindow or DataStore.

events.name: Destructor
events.documentation: Occurs when the DataWindow control or DataStore object is destroyed, immediately after the Close event of a window or form.

events.name: DoubleClicked
events.documentation: Occurs when the user double-clicks in a DataWindow control.

events.name: DropDown
events.documentation: Occurs just before the list provided by a DropDownDataWindow is displayed. Use this event to retrieve new data for the child DataWindow. A DropDownDataWindow is a drop-down choice list whose data is provided by retrieving data for another DataWindow. To create a DropDownDataWindow, you assign the DropDownDataWindow edit style to a column and associate it with another DataWindow that retrieves the data for the choice list.

events.name: EditChanged
events.documentation: Occurs for each keystroke the user types in an edit control in the DataWindow.

events.name: Expanded
events.documentation: Occurs when a node in a TreeView DataWindow has expanded.

events.name: Expanding
events.documentation: Occurs before a node in a TreeView DataWindow expands.

events.name: GetFocus
events.documentation: Occurs just before the control receives focus (before it is selected and becomes active).

events.name: GraphCreate
events.documentation: Occurs after the DataWindow control creates a graph and populates it with data, but before it has displayed the graph. In this event, you can change the appearance of the data about to be displayed.

events.name: HTMLContextApplied
events.documentation: Occurs when the SetHTMLAction method has been called to apply an action to a DataWindow control or DataStore. The event occurs after the context has been set but before the action is applied. PowerBuilder event information Event ID: pbm_dwnhtmlcontextapplied

events.name: ItemChanged
events.documentation: Occurs when a field in a DataWindow control has been modified and loses focus (for example, the user presses Enter, the Tab key, or an arrow key or clicks the mouse on another field within the DataWindow). It occurs before the change is applied to the item. ItemChanged can also occur when the AcceptText or Update method is called for a DataWindow control or DataStore object.

events.name: ItemError
events.documentation: Occurs when a field has been modified, the field loses focus (for example, the user presses Enter, Tab, or an arrow key or clicks the mouse on another field in the DataWindow), and the data in the field does not pass the validation rules for its column. ItemError can also occur when a value imported into a DataWindow control or DataStore does not pass the validation rules for its column.

events.name: ItemFocusChanged
events.documentation: Occurs when the current item in the control changes.

events.name: KeyDown
events.documentation: Occurs for each keystroke when the user is editing in the DataWindow edit control.

events.name: LoseFocus
events.documentation: Occurs just before a control loses focus (after it becomes inactive).

events.name: MessageText
events.documentation: Occurs when a crosstab DataWindow generates a message. Typical messages are Retrieving data and Building crosstab.

events.name: MouseMove
events.documentation: Occurs when the user moves the mouse pointer in a DataWindow control.

events.name: MouseUp
events.documentation: Occurs when the user releases a mouse button in a DataWindow control.

events.name: OnSubmit
events.documentation: This event is triggered just before the Web DataWindow causes a submit. Web DataWindow client control event information Event name: OnSubmit

events.name: Printend
events.documentation: Occurs when the printing of a DataWindow or DataStore ends.

events.name: PrintMarginChange
events.documentation: Occurs when the print margins of the DataWindow change.

events.name: PrintPage
events.documentation: Occurs before each page of the DataWindow or DataStore is formatted for printing.

events.name: PrintStart
events.documentation: Occurs when the printing of the DataWindow or DataStore starts.

events.name: ProcessEnter
events.documentation: Occurs when the user presses the Enter key when focus is in the DataWindow or the DataWindow's edit control.

events.name: RButtonDown
events.documentation: Occurs when the right mouse button is pressed on the DataWindow control.

events.name: Resize
events.documentation: Occurs when the user or a script opens or resizes the client area of a DataWindow control.

events.name: RetrieveEnd
events.documentation: Occurs when the retrieval for the DataWindow or DataStore is complete.

events.name: RetrieveRow
events.documentation: Occurs after a row has been retrieved.

events.name: RetrieveStart
events.documentation: Occurs when the retrieval for the DataWindow or DataStore is about to begin.

events.name: RichTextCurrentStyleChanged
events.documentation: Occurs when a column with the RichText edit style has focus and the current style of the selection or cursor position has changed.

events.name: RichTextLimitError
events.documentation: Occurs when data in a column with the RichText edit style exceeds column size.

events.name: RichTextLoseFocus
events.documentation: Occurs when a column with the RichText edit style loses focus.

events.name: RowFocusChanged
events.documentation: Occurs when the current row changes in the DataWindow.

events.name: RowFocusChanging
events.documentation: Occurs when the current row is about to change in the DataWindow. (The current row of the DataWindow is not necessarily the same as the current row in the database.) The RowFocusChanging event occurs just before the RowFocusChanged event.

events.name: ScrollHorizontal
events.documentation: Occurs when user scrolls left or right in the DataWindow with the tab or arrow keys or the scroll bar.

events.name: ScrollVertical
events.documentation: Occurs when user scrolls up or down in the DataWindow with the Tab or arrow keys or the scroll bar.

events.name: SQLPreview
events.documentation: Occurs immediately before a SQL statement is submitted to the DBMS. Methods that trigger DBMS activity are Retrieve, Update, and ReselectRow.

events.name: TabDownOut
events.documentation: Occurs when the user presses Enter or the down arrow to change focus to the next control in a window or user object.

events.name: TabOut
events.documentation: Occurs when the user presses Tab or, in some edit styles, the right arrow, to move to the next control in a window or user object.

events.name: TabUpOut
events.documentation: Occurs when the user presses Shift+Enter or the up arrow to move to the previous control in a window or user object.

events.name: TreeNodeSelected
events.documentation: Occurs after a node in a TreeView DataWindow is selected.

events.name: TreeNodeSelecting
events.documentation: Occurs before a node in a TreeView DataWindow is selected.

events.name: UpdateEnd
events.documentation: Occurs when all the updates to the database from the DataWindow (or DataStore) are complete.

events.name: UpdateStart
events.documentation: Occurs after a script calls the Update method and just before changes in the DataWindow or DataStore are sent to the database.

events.name: WSError
events.documentation: Occurs when an error is returned for a DataWindow using a Web service data source. The error can occur during any of the following operations: connect, retrieve, delete, insert, update, or disconnect.
